title: Task Status
description: Tracks the lifecycle state of an asynchronous task in the SeatFlow pipeline.

task_type.description: Type category of the task (e.g. INGEST, BACKFILL, PREDICT).

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate task submissions.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the task was created.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the task was last updated.

actor.description: Identity of the actor that created or triggered the task.
